title: The Boards Lied

nodes.speaker: Mizzy Weiss
nodes.text: You're back, you're back and we're right on track. What do you got for me? How'd that puddle scum try and weasel his way out of paying his debts?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're back, you're back and we're right on track. What do you got for me? How'd that puddle scum try and weasel his way out of paying his debts?

nodes.speaker: Mizzy Weiss
nodes.text: A Nata-Log? Yeah, what's the grift? He tryna scalp the times into an algorithm or something? Doesn't matter. Did he give you my money?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A Nata-Log? Yeah, what's the grift? He tryna scalp the times into an algorithm or something? Doesn't matter. Did he give you my money?

nodes.speaker: Mizzy Weiss
nodes.text: Of course he said that! That's what people in debt do. They whine and complain and sop around like a broken TheraPay Bot while splurging on graft upgrades and champagne.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Of course he said that! That's what people in debt do. They whine and complain and sop around like a broken TheraPay Bot while splurging on graft upgrades and champagne.

nodes.speaker: Mizzy Weiss
nodes.text: Hot damn! Not surprised you were able to get it out of him. Knew you had it in you. Alright, I'll take it from here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hot damn! Not surprised you were able to get it out of him. Knew you had it in you. Alright, I'll take it from here.

nodes.speaker: Mizzy Weiss
nodes.text: Well congratulations to him then! He's a good actor and you're a fool. Neon Gods I can't believe I thought you could pull this off. Idiot.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well congratulations to him then! He's a good actor and you're a fool. Neon Gods I can't believe I thought you could pull this off. Idiot.

nodes.speaker: Mizzy Weiss
nodes.text: Bullshit. Are you seriously attempting to blackmail me right now? Maybe try a better story next time.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Bullshit. Are you seriously attempting to blackmail me right now? Maybe try a better story next time.

nodes.speaker: Mizzy Weiss
nodes.text: 3,000 Lims?!?! Are you high?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: 3,000 Lims?!?! Are you high?

nodes.speaker: Mizzy Weiss
nodes.text: Wait, wait, wait! Okay, we can figure this out, can't we? Remember how I said I was gonna teach you to read the boards? Come on! Be a business partner not an asshole.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wait, wait, wait! Okay, we can figure this out, can't we? Remember how I said I was gonna teach you to read the boards? Come on! Be a business partner not an asshole.

nodes.speaker: Mizzy Weiss
nodes.text: 1,000 Lims?!? Are you high?!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: 1,000 Lims?!? Are you high?!

nodes.speaker: Mizzy Weiss
nodes.text: You.... I.... Half of me wants to play a round of cards with you while the other half wants to watch you get mangled beneath a train. Here, now give me that and get the fuck out of here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You.... I.... Half of me wants to play a round of cards with you while the other half wants to watch you get mangled beneath a train. Here, now give me that and get the fuck out of here.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: He gave me this.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He gave me this.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: He had no money on him.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He had no money on him.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: He had no money on him.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: He had no money on him.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No excuses, just money.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No excuses, just money.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: He actually didn't pay me. I was joking.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He actually didn't pay me. I was joking.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: He actually didn't pay me. I was joking.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: He actually didn't pay me. I was joking.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Didn't look like he was splurging.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Didn't look like he was splurging.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Didn't look like he was splurging.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Didn't look like he was splurging.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It's a transcription of some unsavory conversations between you and the conductors.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's a transcription of some unsavory conversations between you and the conductors.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It's a transcription of some unsavory conversations between you and the conductors.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It's a transcription of some unsavory conversations between you and the conductors.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Suit yourself.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Suit yourself.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You don't think the person who gave you the back door channels could record them?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You don't think the person who gave you the back door channels could record them?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You don't think the person who gave you the back door channels could record them?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You don't think the person who gave you the back door channels could record them?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: 1,000 Lims and it goes away.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: 1,000 Lims and it goes away.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: 3,000 Lims and it goes away.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: 3,000 Lims and it goes away.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Terms are terms.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Terms are terms.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Pleasure doing business with you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Pleasure doing business with you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Look at it!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look at it!
